rules.statement: A plaintiff's evasion of section 272 of the Civil Procedure Code or conditions imposed by the Court with regard to purchasing at a Fiscal's sale is merely an irregularity, but does not invalidate the sale once confirmed and a Fiscal's transfer issued.
rules.supporting_quote: These cases are Silva v. Siyadoris [1] and Weeraman v. De Silva,[2], but Mr. Soertsz, for the defendant, contends that there still remains a question of law whether it is not fraud and collusion between the plaintiff and the defendant when the property was purchased at a less price than the appraised value by the defendant on behalf of the plaintiff. I am myself unable to follow the argument that the transaction amounted to fraud.
